we have collected an auditory attention dataset using eeg, gaze, vision modalities during an auditory attention task
there are 100 trials for the main experiment and 10 trials for training the subject about the process they are listed under /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/experiment_data
the eeg data for example for experiment 1 for subject 1 is at /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/experiment_data/Subject 1/Eval-1/eeg_data.p and 
the gaze data for this experiment at  Collection/experiment_data/Subject 1/Eval-1/gaze_data.p
The order of the files in the directory /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/Video Recordings/Subject X/ are from 1-105 which correponds to the first 5 training trials, followed by the 100 main trials
the raw gaze data is at /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/Video Recordings/Subject 1/6/gazedata.gz
the imu data is at  /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/Video Recordings/Subject 1/6/imudata.gz
the video recording is at /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/Video Recordings/Subject 1/6/scenevideo.mp4
the control answers for each trial (to assure the attendance to the task) are at /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/experiment_data/Subject 1/answers.json
the demographic data is at /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/experiment_data/Subject 1/demographic.json
the audio played at each trial is listed at /fs/ess/PAS2301/Data/AAD Data Collection/audio_stimuli_data/trials.csv in this file the "Attended Speaker" is 1-4. it corresponds to Device-1 left and right and Device-2 left and right in that order. Device-3 speakers are in the back and playing noise. the position of electrodes from Device-1 left and right, Device-2 left and right and Device-3 left and right are at -67.5 -22.5 22.5 67.5 -135 135 degrees and at the distance of 4 foot. in this file the SNR is with respoect to the attended speaker. Audios are played at different power mentioned in the corresponding column. Question answer and options columns are the questions asked for each played audio attendance verification. 
The corresponding audio played at each speaker (both left and right but with different powers).
